mentions.name: Three Emojis
mentions.description: This is the author's own puzzle website; the author has gone back and forth on generating a shareable story of a completed puzzle, noting how hard it is to convey a complicated puzzle to someone who wasn't playing it.
mentions.source_excerpt: This is something I've gone and forth on for https://threeemojis.com/ as well. I think it's pretty hard to generate a story of a complicated puzzle, in part because the person you are sending it to doesn't have an idea of the terrain you were playing on and so kind of doesn't care.
